title: Array.includes with coercion
starterCode:
const arr = [0, 1, 2, 3, "0", "1"]
return {
  hasZero: arr.includes(0),
  hasStringZero: arr.includes("0"),
  indexOfZero: arr.indexOf(0),
  indexOfStringZero: arr.indexOf("0")
}
solution:
const arr = [0, 1, 2, 3, "0", "1"]
return {
  hasZero: arr.includes(0),
  hasStringZero: arr.includes("0"),
  indexOfZero: arr.indexOf(0),
  indexOfStringZero: arr.indexOf("0")
}
